name: Filson
why: Alaska Gold Rush outfitter, 1897 — Mackinaw wool and tin cloth, still repaired.
origin: C.C. Filson, Seattle, 1897 — outfitting Gold Rush prospectors bound for the Klondike.
opview: “Might as well have the best” — the founder's slogan since 1897.

onething.n: own-site search, not opened from this environment. Patented 1914 and the garment the rest of the line is measured against

notes.murica: outfitted the Klondike — 'Might as well have the best' as frontier doctrine

cities: Seattle flagship + ~15 stores · Chicago (Mildblend), Boulder (Canoe Club)
